By Stefan Acevski / info@eurohoops.net
Tyrese Haliburton has suffered a left hamstring strain and is expected to take a break, confirmed NBA insider Shams Charania.
“Indiana Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton has sustained a left hamstring strain and will miss time. Pacers doctors and Haliburton are now gathering a clear timeline.”
Haliburton had an excellent start to the season after returning from a 16-month break due to a torn Achilles tendon, but he has now experienced a new setback.
Indiana fans hope that the recovery will not take long. So far this season, Haliburton has played 4 games, averaging 21.5 points, 9.5 assists, and 4.5 rebounds.
